@@ -0,0 +1,154 @@
+# PA01 probe (required checks): drives one fixed sequence of check-run writes on a fresh head commit of the probe
+# PR and records the PR's merge state (REST mergeable_state) after every write.
+# Canonical source: probes/pa01-required-checks/workflows/probe-pa01-sequence.yml
+# Deployed copy:    .github/workflows/probe-pa01-sequence.yml on master (byte-identical).
+# Preconditions, created by the probe step: branch probe-pa01-base; ruleset probe-pa01-required on exactly
+# refs/heads/probe-pa01-base requiring the status check "probe-pa01/required" from integration 4993303 (the test
+# App); branch probe-pa01-head-1 holding probe-pa01/head.txt; an open PR probe-pa01-head-1 -> probe-pa01-base.
+# The job never checks out or runs PR content. Every fact is a log line starting "PROBE-PA01 ".
+name: probe-pa01-sequence
+run-name: probe-pa01-sequence ${{ inputs.nonce }}
+
+on:
+  workflow_dispatch:
+    inputs:
+      nonce:
+        description: Unique marker that lets the dispatching script find this run
+        required: true
+        type: string
+      pr:
+        description: Number of the open probe PR (head probe-pa01-head-1, base probe-pa01-base)
+        required: true
+        type: string
+
+permissions: {}
+
+jobs:
+  sequence:
+    name: sequence
+    if: ${{ github.event.sender.login == 'jambolo' }}
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 45
+    permissions:
+      checks: write
+      contents: read
+      pull-requests: read
+    steps:
+      - name: Mint an App installation token
+        id: app
+        uses: actions/create-github-app-token@v3
+        with:
+          app-id: ${{ secrets.STEWARD_APP_ID }}
+          private-key: ${{ secrets.STEWARD_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
+          permission-checks: write
+          permission-contents: write
+          permission-pull-requests: read
+
+      - name: Run the check-run sequence and record the merge state after each write
+        env:
+          APP_TOKEN: ${{ steps.app.outputs.token }}
+          JOB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
+          PR: ${{ inputs.pr }}
+          NONCE: ${{ inputs.nonce }}
+          CHECK_NAME: probe-pa01/required
+          HEAD_BRANCH: probe-pa01-head-1
+          HEAD_FILE: probe-pa01/head.txt
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          R="$GITHUB_REPOSITORY"
+          RUN_URL="$GITHUB_SERVER_URL/$R/actions/runs/$GITHUB_RUN_ID"
+          case "$PR" in '' | *[!0-9]*) echo "PROBE-PA01 error=pr-not-a-number"; exit 1 ;; esac
+          utc() { date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ; }
+          log() { echo "PROBE-PA01 $*"; }
+          state() { GH_TOKEN="$JOB_TOKEN" gh api "repos/$R/pulls/$PR" --jq .mergeable_state; }
+
+          # observe <step>: poll every 20 s, at most 5 times; stop at the first known state that differs from PREV.
+          observe() {
+            local label="$1" t0 now st i
+            t0=$(date +%s)
+            SETTLED=unknown
+            CHANGED=no
+            LATENCY=none
+            for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do
+              sleep 20
+              st="$(state)"
+              now=$(date +%s)
+              log "step=$label poll=$i t_s=$((now - t0)) mergeable_state=$st"
+              if [ "$st" != unknown ]; then SETTLED="$st"; fi
+              if [ "$st" != unknown ] && [ "$st" != "$PREV" ]; then
+                CHANGED=yes
+                LATENCY=$((now - t0))
+                break
+              fi
+            done
+            log "step=$label settled=$SETTLED changed=$CHANGED latency_s=$LATENCY prev=$PREV utc=$(utc)"
+            PREV="$SETTLED"
+          }
+
+          # create <app|job> <status-or-empty> <conclusion-or-empty>: create a check run on HEAD_SHA; prints "id app status conclusion"
+          create() {
+            local tok="$APP_TOKEN"
+            if [ "$1" = job ]; then tok="$JOB_TOKEN"; fi
+            local args=(-X POST "repos/$R/check-runs" -f name="$CHECK_NAME" -f head_sha="$HEAD_SHA" -f details_url="$RUN_URL" -f external_id="$NONCE")
+            if [ -n "$3" ]; then
+              args+=(-f status=completed -f conclusion="$3" -f "output[title]=probe PA01" -f "output[summary]=conclusion $3")
+            else
+              args+=(-f status="$2")
+            fi
+            GH_TOKEN="$tok" gh api "${args[@]}" --jq '"\(.id) \(.app.slug) \(.status) \(.conclusion)"'
+          }
+
+          # complete <id> <conclusion>: complete an existing check run with the App token
+          complete() {
+            GH_TOKEN="$APP_TOKEN" gh api -X PATCH "repos/$R/check-runs/$1" -f status=completed -f conclusion="$2" \
+              -f details_url="$RUN_URL" -f "output[title]=probe PA01" -f "output[summary]=conclusion $2" \
+              --jq '"\(.id) \(.app.slug) \(.status) \(.conclusion)"'
+          }
+
+          w() { log "step=$1 write=\"$2\" result=\"$3\" utc=$(utc)"; }
+
+          log "start repository=$R pr=$PR check_name=$CHECK_NAME run_url=$RUN_URL utc=$(utc)"
+
+          # S0: a fresh head commit, so that no check run of an earlier attempt exists on it.
+          cur="$(GH_TOKEN="$APP_TOKEN" gh api "repos/$R/contents/$HEAD_FILE?ref=$HEAD_BRANCH" --jq .sha 2> /dev/null || true)"
+          put=(-X PUT "repos/$R/contents/$HEAD_FILE" -f message="probe(PA01): fresh head $NONCE" -f branch="$HEAD_BRANCH"
+            -f content="$(printf 'probe PA01 head %s\n' "$NONCE" | base64 -w0)")
+          if [ -n "$cur" ]; then put+=(-f sha="$cur"); fi
+          HEAD_SHA="$(GH_TOKEN="$APP_TOKEN" gh api "${put[@]}" --jq .commit.sha)"
+          log "step=S0 write=\"app token commit to $HEAD_BRANCH\" head_sha=$HEAD_SHA utc=$(utc)"
+          synced=no
+          for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 9; do
+            sleep 20
+            h="$(GH_TOKEN="$JOB_TOKEN" gh api "repos/$R/pulls/$PR" --jq .head.sha)"
+            if [ "$h" = "$HEAD_SHA" ]; then synced=yes; break; fi
+          done
+          log "step=S0 pr_head_synced=$synced"
+          if [ "$synced" != yes ]; then exit 1; fi
+          PREV=start
+          observe S0
+
+          r="$(create app in_progress '')"; A="${r%% *}"; w S1a "app create in_progress (run A)" "$r"; observe S1a
+          r="$(complete "$A" success)"; w S1b "app complete run A success" "$r"; observe S1b
+          r="$(create app in_progress '')"; B="${r%% *}"; w S2 "app create in_progress (run B, same name, same commit)" "$r"; observe S2
+          r="$(complete "$B" failure)"; w S3 "app complete run B failure (A is an older success)" "$r"; observe S3
+          r="$(create app '' neutral)"; w S4 "app create completed neutral" "$r"; observe S4
+          r="$(create app '' action_required)"; w S5 "app create completed action_required" "$r"; observe S5
+          r="$(create app '' success)"; w S6 "app create completed success" "$r"; observe S6
+          r="$(create app '' cancelled)"; w S7 "app create completed cancelled" "$r"; observe S7
+          r="$(create app in_progress '')"; H1="${r%% *}"; w S8a "app create in_progress (older run H1)" "$r"; observe S8a
+          r="$(create app '' success)"; w S8b "app create completed success (newer run H2)" "$r"; observe S8b
+          r="$(complete "$H1" cancelled)"; w S8c "app complete OLDER run H1 cancelled after newer H2 exists" "$r"; observe S8c
+          r="$(create app '' failure)"; w S9a "app create completed failure" "$r"; observe S9a
+          r="$(create job '' success)"; w S9b "job GITHUB_TOKEN (app github-actions) create completed success" "$r"; observe S9b
+          r="$(create app '' success)"; w S10a "app create completed success (reset)" "$r"; observe S10a
+          r="$(create app '' skipped)"; w S10b "app create completed skipped" "$r"; observe S10b
+          r="$(create app '' success)"; w S11a "app create completed success (reset)" "$r"; observe S11a
+          r="$(create app '' timed_out)"; w S11b "app create completed timed_out" "$r"; observe S11b
+
+          log "check-runs filter=all (oldest first):"
+          GH_TOKEN="$JOB_TOKEN" gh api "repos/$R/commits/$HEAD_SHA/check-runs?check_name=$CHECK_NAME&filter=all&per_page=100" \
+            --jq '.check_runs | sort_by(.id) | .[] | "PROBE-PA01 check_run id=\(.id) app=\(.app.slug) status=\(.status) conclusion=\(.conclusion) started_at=\(.started_at) completed_at=\(.completed_at)"'
+          log "check-runs filter=latest:"
+          GH_TOKEN="$JOB_TOKEN" gh api "repos/$R/commits/$HEAD_SHA/check-runs?check_name=$CHECK_NAME&filter=latest&per_page=100" \
+            --jq '.check_runs[] | "PROBE-PA01 latest id=\(.id) app=\(.app.slug) status=\(.status) conclusion=\(.conclusion)"'
+          log "done head_sha=$HEAD_SHA utc=$(utc)"

@@ -0,0 +1,128 @@
+# PA03 probe (trusted triggers): records which workflow definition (PROBE_DEFINITION) and which ref a run of each
+# trusted trigger uses, whether a default-branch-only Environment admits the job and delivers its secret, and
+# whether a ref guard stops a workflow_dispatch run on a non-default ref before any credential is used.
+# Canonical source: probes/pa03-trusted-triggers/workflows/probe-pa03-events.yml
+# Deployed copy:    .github/workflows/probe-pa03-events.yml on master (byte-identical).
+# Variants that differ only in PROBE_DEFINITION (and, for -noguard, in the environment job's `needs: guard`) live
+# under probes/pa03-trusted-triggers/fixtures/ and are deployed to probe-pa03-base, probe-pa03-base-noguard, and
+# PR head branches. Markers: PR or issue title starts "[probe PA03]"; comment body starts "/probe-pa03".
+# The Environment secret PROBE_PA03_ENV_MARKER holds the DUMMY value "probe-pa03-env-marker-v1"; only its length and
+# whether its SHA-256 digest matches are printed. No job checks out or runs PR content.
+name: probe-pa03-events
+run-name: >-
+  probe-pa03-events ${{ github.event_name }}
+  ${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.event.issue.number || github.event.workflow_run.id || inputs.nonce }}
+
+on:
+  pull_request_target:
+    types: [opened, reopened, synchronize]
+  issues:
+    types: [opened, reopened]
+  issue_comment:
+    types: [created]
+  workflow_run:
+    workflows: [probe-pa03-upstream]
+    types: [completed]
+  workflow_dispatch:
+    inputs:
+      nonce:
+        description: Unique marker that lets the dispatching script find this run
+        required: false
+        type: string
+        default: ''
+
+permissions: {}
+
+env:
+  PROBE_DEFINITION: default-branch
+
+jobs:
+  guard:
+    name: guard
+    if: >-
+      ${{ github.repository != 'jambolo/patch-steward-testbed-public' && (
+      (github.event_name == 'pull_request_target' && startsWith(github.event.pull_request.title, '[probe PA03]')) ||
+      (github.event_name == 'issues' && startsWith(github.event.issue.title, '[probe PA03]')) ||
+      (github.event_name == 'issue_comment' && startsWith(github.event.comment.body, '/probe-pa03')) ||
+      github.event_name == 'workflow_run' ||
+      (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && github.event.sender.login == 'jambolo')) }}
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 5
+    permissions: {}
+    steps:
+      - name: Reject a workflow_dispatch run on any ref other than the default branch
+        env:
+          DEFAULT_BRANCH: ${{ github.event.repository.default_branch }}
+        run: |
+          echo "PROBE-PA03 job=guard definition=$PROBE_DEFINITION event_name=$GITHUB_EVENT_NAME ref=$GITHUB_REF default_branch=$DEFAULT_BRANCH"
+          if [ "$GITHUB_EVENT_NAME" = workflow_dispatch ] && [ "$GITHUB_REF" != "refs/heads/$DEFAULT_BRANCH" ]; then
+            echo "PROBE-PA03 job=guard verdict=reject reason=non-default-ref"
+            exit 1
+          fi
+          echo "PROBE-PA03 job=guard verdict=pass"
+
+  record:
+    name: record
+    if: >-
+      ${{ github.repository != 'jambolo/patch-steward-testbed-public' && (
+      (github.event_name == 'pull_request_target' && startsWith(github.event.pull_request.title, '[probe PA03]')) ||
+      (github.event_name == 'issues' && startsWith(github.event.issue.title, '[probe PA03]')) ||
+      (github.event_name == 'issue_comment' && startsWith(github.event.comment.body, '/probe-pa03')) ||
+      github.event_name == 'workflow_run' ||
+      (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && github.event.sender.login == 'jambolo')) }}
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 5
+    permissions: {}
+    steps:
+      - name: Record the definition and the ref of this run
+        env:
+          ACTION: ${{ github.event.action }}
+          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
+          PR_BASE: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.ref }}
+          PR_HEAD_REPO: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name }}
+          PR_HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
+          ISSUE_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.issue.number }}
+          WR_ID: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.id }}
+          WR_HEAD_BRANCH: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_branch }}
+          WR_EVENT: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.event }}
+          SENDER: ${{ github.event.sender.login }}
+        run: |
+          echo "PROBE-PA03 job=record definition=$PROBE_DEFINITION"
+          echo "PROBE-PA03 job=record event_name=$GITHUB_EVENT_NAME action=$ACTION sender=$SENDER"
+          echo "PROBE-PA03 job=record ref=$GITHUB_REF sha=$GITHUB_SHA"
+          echo "PROBE-PA03 job=record workflow_ref=$GITHUB_WORKFLOW_REF workflow_sha=$GITHUB_WORKFLOW_SHA"
+          echo "PROBE-PA03 job=record base_ref=$GITHUB_BASE_REF head_ref=$GITHUB_HEAD_REF"
+          echo "PROBE-PA03 job=record pr=$PR_NUMBER pr_base=$PR_BASE pr_head_repo=$PR_HEAD_REPO pr_head_sha=$PR_HEAD_SHA issue=$ISSUE_NUMBER"
+          echo "PROBE-PA03 job=record workflow_run_id=$WR_ID workflow_run_head_branch=$WR_HEAD_BRANCH workflow_run_event=$WR_EVENT"
+          echo "PROBE-PA03 job=record run_id=$GITHUB_RUN_ID run_attempt=$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT utc=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
+
+  environment:
+    name: environment
+    needs: guard
+    if: >-
+      ${{ github.repository != 'jambolo/patch-steward-testbed-public' &&
+      (github.event.sender.login == 'jambolo' || github.event.sender.login == 'patch-steward-testbed[bot]') && (
+      (github.event_name == 'pull_request_target' && startsWith(github.event.pull_request.title, '[probe PA03]')) ||
+      (github.event_name == 'issues' && startsWith(github.event.issue.title, '[probe PA03]')) ||
+      (github.event_name == 'issue_comment' && startsWith(github.event.comment.body, '/probe-pa03')) ||
+      github.event_name == 'workflow_run' ||
+      github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch') }}
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 5
+    environment: probe-pa03-default-branch
+    permissions: {}
+    steps:
+      - name: Record whether the Environment admitted this job and delivered its secret
+        env:
+          MARKER: ${{ secrets.PROBE_PA03_ENV_MARKER }}
+          EXPECTED_SHA256: f996c284eb4344741cf5aeb9decd8015ba40c71b078608a50532c1b33e6a02b2
+        run: |
+          echo "PROBE-PA03 job=environment definition=$PROBE_DEFINITION event_name=$GITHUB_EVENT_NAME ref=$GITHUB_REF"
+          echo "PROBE-PA03 job=environment environment=probe-pa03-default-branch secret_length=${#MARKER}"
+          actual="$(printf '%s' "$MARKER" | sha256sum | cut -d ' ' -f 1)"
+          if [ "$actual" = "$EXPECTED_SHA256" ]; then
+            echo "PROBE-PA03 job=environment secret_digest=match"
+          else
+            echo "PROBE-PA03 job=environment secret_digest=mismatch"
+          fi
+          echo "PROBE-PA03 job=environment run_id=$GITHUB_RUN_ID utc=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"

+# PA03 probe (trusted triggers): the upstream run whose completion starts a workflow_run run of
+# probe-pa03-events.yml. Dispatched on the NON-default branch probe-pa03-base (PA03.3).
+# Canonical source: probes/pa03-trusted-triggers/workflows/probe-pa03-upstream.yml
+# Deployed copy:    .github/workflows/probe-pa03-upstream.yml on master and on probe-pa03-base (byte-identical).
+name: probe-pa03-upstream
+run-name: probe-pa03-upstream ${{ inputs.nonce }}
+
+on:
+  workflow_dispatch:
+    inputs:
+      nonce:
+        description: Unique marker that lets the dispatching script find this run
+        required: true
+        type: string
+
+permissions: {}
+
+jobs:
+  upstream:
+    name: upstream
+    if: ${{ github.repository != 'jambolo/patch-steward-testbed-public' && github.event.sender.login == 'jambolo' }}
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 5
+    permissions: {}
+    steps:
+      - name: Record the ref of the upstream run
+        run: echo "PROBE-PA03 job=upstream ref=$GITHUB_REF sha=$GITHUB_SHA run_id=$GITHUB_RUN_ID utc=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"

+# PA04 probe (job privilege separation), PA04.2: reusable workflow whose jobs REQUEST token permissions. The
+# "Set up job" section of each job's log lists the GITHUB_TOKEN permissions actually granted. No job sends a Copilot
+# request or writes anything.
+# Canonical source: probes/pa04-privilege-separation/workflows/probe-pa04-callee-perms.yml
+# Deployed copy:    .github/workflows/probe-pa04-callee-perms.yml on master (byte-identical).
+name: probe-pa04-callee-perms
+
+on:
+  workflow_call:
+    inputs:
+      leg:
+        description: Which caller this is (omit-issues, omit-copilot, grant)
+        required: true
+        type: string
+
+permissions: {}
+
+jobs:
+  wants-issues:
+    name: wants-issues
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 5
+    permissions:
+      contents: read
+      issues: write
+    steps:
+      - name: Record that this job ran
+        env:
+          LEG: ${{ inputs.leg }}
+        run: echo "PROBE-PA04 leg=$LEG job=callee-perms/wants-issues ran=yes requested=contents:read,issues:write"
+
+  wants-copilot:
+    name: wants-copilot
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 5
+    permissions:
+      contents: read
+      copilot-requests: write
+    steps:
+      - name: Record that this job ran (no Copilot request is sent)
+        env:
+          LEG: ${{ inputs.leg }}
+        run: echo "PROBE-PA04 leg=$LEG job=callee-perms/wants-copilot ran=yes requested=contents:read,copilot-requests:write"

@@ -0,0 +1,41 @@
+# PA04 probe (job privilege separation), PA04.2: permission ceiling of a reusable-workflow call. The calling job
+# grants contents:read + issues:write + copilot-requests:write (everything the callee requests).
+# probe-pa04-callee-perms.yml requests contents:read + issues:write (job wants-issues) and contents:read +
+# copilot-requests:write (job wants-copilot). Job control runs beside the call, so the run shows whether a violation
+# fails the whole run at startup, fails only the calling job, or silently downgrades the token. No Copilot request.
+# Canonical source: probes/pa04-privilege-separation/workflows/probe-pa04-ceiling-grant.yml
+# Deployed copy:    .github/workflows/probe-pa04-ceiling-grant.yml on master (byte-identical).
+name: probe-pa04-ceiling-grant
+run-name: probe-pa04-ceiling-grant ${{ inputs.nonce }}
+
+on:
+  workflow_dispatch:
+    inputs:
+      nonce:
+        description: Unique marker that lets the dispatching script find this run
+        required: true
+        type: string
+
+permissions: {}
+
+jobs:
+  control:
+    name: control
+    if: ${{ github.event.sender.login == 'jambolo' }}
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 5
+    permissions: {}
+    steps:
+      - name: Record that the control job ran
+        run: echo "PROBE-PA04 leg=grant job=control ran=yes"
+
+  call:
+    name: call
+    if: ${{ github.event.sender.login == 'jambolo' }}
+    permissions:
+      contents: read
+      copilot-requests: write
+      issues: write
+    uses: ./.github/workflows/probe-pa04-callee-perms.yml
+    with:
+      leg: grant

+# PA04 probe (job privilege separation), PA04.1: which jobs of one run receive the Environment secret. Caller jobs
+# with and without the Environment, plus three calls of probe-pa04-callee.yml: same repository, and pinned by commit

+# PA04 probe (job privilege separation), PA04.3 and PA04.4: a reusable workflow shaped like the design's pipeline
+# (gate -> intake -> execute -> assess, then publish with the design's condition). Inputs choose which job fails,
+# which is skipped, and whether the run cancels itself while execute is running. Every job logs one line
+# "PROBE-PA04 scenario=<s> job=<name> ..." so the log shows which jobs ran.
+# Canonical source: probes/pa04-privilege-separation/workflows/probe-pa04-pipeline.yml
+# Deployed copy:    .github/workflows/probe-pa04-pipeline.yml on master (byte-identical).
+name: probe-pa04-pipeline
+
+on:
+  workflow_call:
+    inputs:
+      scenario:
+        required: true
+        type: string
+      gate_result:
+        description: success | failure
+        required: true
+        type: string
+      committed:
+        description: 'true | false (gate output)'
+        required: true
+        type: string
+      execute_result:
+        description: success | failure
+        required: true
+        type: string
+      skip_assess:
+        description: 'true skips assess by its own if'
+        required: true
+        type: string
+      cancel_after:
+        description: seconds after which job canceller cancels this run; 0 = never
+        required: true
+        type: string
+
+permissions: {}
+
+jobs:
+  gate:
+    name: gate
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 5
+    permissions: {}
+    outputs:
+      committed: ${{ steps.commit.outputs.committed }}
+    steps:
+      - name: Set the committed output
+        id: commit
+        env:
+          COMMITTED: ${{ inputs.committed }}
+          SCENARIO: ${{ inputs.scenario }}
+        run: |
+          echo "committed=$COMMITTED" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+          echo "PROBE-PA04 scenario=$SCENARIO job=gate committed=$COMMITTED utc=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
+      - name: Fail the gate when asked
+        if: ${{ inputs.gate_result == 'failure' }}
+        env:
+          SCENARIO: ${{ inputs.scenario }}
+        run: |
+          echo "PROBE-PA04 scenario=$SCENARIO job=gate failing=yes"
+          exit 1
+
+  intake:
+    name: intake
+    needs: gate
+    if: ${{ needs.gate.outputs.committed == 'true' }}
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 5
+    permissions: {}
+    steps:
+      - name: Intake
+        env:
+          SCENARIO: ${{ inputs.scenario }}
+          COMMITTED: ${{ needs.gate.outputs.committed }}
+        run: echo "PROBE-PA04 scenario=$SCENARIO job=intake ran=yes gate_committed_seen=$COMMITTED"
+
+  execute:
+    name: execute
+    needs: intake
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 10
+    permissions: {}
+    steps:
+      - name: Hold while the canceller acts (cancel scenario only)
+        if: ${{ inputs.cancel_after != '0' }}
+        env:
+          SCENARIO: ${{ inputs.scenario }}
+        run: |
+          echo "PROBE-PA04 scenario=$SCENARIO job=execute hold_start_utc=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
+          sleep 300
+          echo "PROBE-PA04 scenario=$SCENARIO job=execute hold_end_utc=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
+      - name: Fail execute when asked
+        if: ${{ inputs.execute_result == 'failure' }}
+        env:
+          SCENARIO: ${{ inputs.scenario }}
+        run: |
+          echo "PROBE-PA04 scenario=$SCENARIO job=execute failing=yes"
+          exit 1
+      - name: Execute
+        env:
+          SCENARIO: ${{ inputs.scenario }}
+        run: echo "PROBE-PA04 scenario=$SCENARIO job=execute ran=yes"
+
+  assess:
+    name: assess
+    needs: execute
+    if: ${{ inputs.skip_assess != 'true' }}
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 5
+    permissions: {}
+    steps:
+      - name: Assess
+        env:
+          SCENARIO: ${{ inputs.scenario }}
+        run: echo "PROBE-PA04 scenario=$SCENARIO job=assess ran=yes"
+
+  canceller:
+    name: canceller
+    needs: gate
+    if: ${{ inputs.cancel_after != '0' }}
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 5
+    permissions:
+      actions: write
+    steps:
+      - name: Cancel this workflow run while execute is running
+        env:
+          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
+          SCENARIO: ${{ inputs.scenario }}
+          AFTER: ${{ inputs.cancel_after }}
+        run: |
+          case "$AFTER" in '' | *[!0-9]*) AFTER=30 ;; esac
+          sleep "$AFTER"
+          echo "PROBE-PA04 scenario=$SCENARIO job=canceller cancel_request_utc=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
+          gh api -X POST "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/runs/$GITHUB_RUN_ID/cancel"
+          sleep 60
+          echo "PROBE-PA04 scenario=$SCENARIO job=canceller still_running_after_60s=yes"
+
+  publish:
+    name: publish
+    needs: [gate, intake, execute, assess]
+    if: ${{ always() && needs.gate.result == 'success' && needs.gate.outputs.committed == 'true' }}
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 5
+    permissions: {}
+    steps:
+      - name: Publish
+        env:
+          SCENARIO: ${{ inputs.scenario }}
+          GATE: ${{ needs.gate.result }}
+          INTAKE: ${{ needs.intake.result }}
+          EXECUTE: ${{ needs.execute.result }}
+          ASSESS: ${{ needs.assess.result }}
+          COMMITTED: ${{ needs.gate.outputs.committed }}
+        run: echo "PROBE-PA04 scenario=$SCENARIO job=publish ran=yes gate=$GATE intake=$INTAKE execute=$EXECUTE assess=$ASSESS committed=$COMMITTED utc=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"

+# PA04 probe (job privilege separation), PA04.3 and PA04.4: dispatches one scenario of probe-pa04-pipeline.yml.
+#   A  every job succeeds                         D  gate fails
+#   B  execute fails (assess skipped by needs)    E  gate output committed is 'false'
+#   C  assess skipped by its own condition        F  the run cancels itself while execute is running
+# Canonical source: probes/pa04-privilege-separation/workflows/probe-pa04-publish.yml
+# Deployed copy:    .github/workflows/probe-pa04-publish.yml on master (byte-identical).
+name: probe-pa04-publish
+run-name: probe-pa04-publish ${{ inputs.scenario }} ${{ inputs.nonce }}
+
+on:
+  workflow_dispatch:
+    inputs:
+      nonce:
+        description: Unique marker that lets the dispatching script find this run
+        required: true
+        type: string
+      scenario:
+        description: A | B | C | D | E | F
+        required: true
+        type: string
+
+permissions: {}
+
+jobs:
+  pipeline:
+    name: pipeline
+    if: ${{ github.event.sender.login == 'jambolo' }}
+    permissions:
+      actions: write
+    uses: ./.github/workflows/probe-pa04-pipeline.yml
+    with:
+      scenario: ${{ inputs.scenario }}
+      gate_result: ${{ inputs.scenario == 'D' && 'failure' || 'success' }}
+      committed: ${{ inputs.scenario == 'E' && 'false' || 'true' }}
+      execute_result: ${{ inputs.scenario == 'B' && 'failure' || 'success' }}
+      skip_assess: ${{ inputs.scenario == 'C' && 'true' || 'false' }}
+      cancel_after: ${{ inputs.scenario == 'F' && '30' || '0' }}

+# PA06 probe (merge-queue relay): test-driver actions that the local token cannot perform itself.
+#   check    create a completed App check run "probe-pa06/gate" (conclusion <conclusion>) on each commit in <shas>
+#   enqueue  add PR <pr> to its merge queue (GraphQL enqueuePullRequest) with the token chosen by <token>
+#   dequeue  remove PR <pr> from its merge queue (GraphQL dequeuePullRequest) with the token chosen by <token>
+# <token>: github = the job GITHUB_TOKEN (contents, pull-requests write); app = the test App installation token.
+# Every response is logged verbatim in lines starting "PROBE-PA06 ".
+# Canonical source: probes/pa06-merge-queue-relay/workflows/probe-pa06-control.yml
+# Deployed copy:    .github/workflows/probe-pa06-control.yml on master (byte-identical).
+name: probe-pa06-control
+run-name: probe-pa06-control ${{ inputs.action }} ${{ inputs.nonce }}
+
+on:
+  workflow_dispatch:
+    inputs:
+      nonce:
+        description: Unique marker that lets the dispatching script find this run
+        required: true
+        type: string
+      action:
+        description: check | enqueue | dequeue
+        required: true
+        type: string
+      shas:
+        description: check - space-separated 40-hex commit SHAs
+        required: false
+        type: string
+        default: ''
+      conclusion:
+        description: check - success | failure | neutral
+        required: false
+        type: string
+        default: success
+      pr:
+        description: enqueue/dequeue - PR number
+        required: false
+        type: string
+        default: ''
+      token:
+        description: enqueue/dequeue - github | app
+        required: false
+        type: string
+        default: github
+
+permissions: {}
+
+jobs:
+  control:
+    name: control
+    if: ${{ github.event.sender.login == 'jambolo' }}
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 10
+    permissions:
+      contents: write
+      pull-requests: write
+    steps:
+      - name: Mint an App installation token
+        id: app
+        uses: actions/create-github-app-token@v3
+        with:
+          app-id: ${{ secrets.STEWARD_APP_ID }}
+          private-key: ${{ secrets.STEWARD_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
+          permission-checks: write
+          permission-contents: write
+          permission-pull-requests: write
+
+      - name: Perform the action
+        env:
+          APP_TOKEN: ${{ steps.app.outputs.token }}
+          JOB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
+          ACTION: ${{ inputs.action }}
+          SHAS: ${{ inputs.shas }}
+          CONCLUSION: ${{ inputs.conclusion }}
+          PR: ${{ inputs.pr }}
+          TOKEN_KIND: ${{ inputs.token }}
+        run: |
+          set +e
+          R="$GITHUB_REPOSITORY"
+          utc() { date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ; }
+          case "$ACTION" in
+            check)
+              case "$CONCLUSION" in success | failure | neutral) ;; *) echo "PROBE-PA06 error=bad-conclusion"; exit 1 ;; esac
+              for s in $SHAS; do
+                case "$s" in *[!0-9a-f]*) echo "PROBE-PA06 error=bad-sha"; exit 1 ;; esac
+                if [ "${#s}" != 40 ]; then echo "PROBE-PA06 error=bad-sha-length"; exit 1; fi
+                out="$(GH_TOKEN="$APP_TOKEN" gh api -X POST "repos/$R/check-runs" -f name=probe-pa06/gate -f head_sha="$s" \
+                  -f status=completed -f conclusion="$CONCLUSION" -f 'output[title]=probe PA06' -f "output[summary]=control $CONCLUSION" \
+                  --jq '"id=\(.id) app=\(.app.slug) conclusion=\(.conclusion) completed_at=\(.completed_at)"' 2>&1)"
+                echo "PROBE-PA06 control action=check sha=$s exit=$? result=$(printf '%s' "$out" | tr '\n' ' ') utc=$(utc)"
+              done
+              ;;
+            enqueue | dequeue)
+              case "$PR" in '' | *[!0-9]*) echo "PROBE-PA06 error=pr-not-a-number"; exit 1 ;; esac
+              if [ "$TOKEN_KIND" = app ]; then tok="$APP_TOKEN"; else tok="$JOB_TOKEN"; TOKEN_KIND=github; fi
+              node="$(GH_TOKEN="$JOB_TOKEN" gh api "repos/$R/pulls/$PR" --jq .node_id)"
+              if [ "$ACTION" = enqueue ]; then
+                q='mutation($id: ID!) { enqueuePullRequest(input: {pullRequestId: $id}) { mergeQueueEntry { position state enqueuedAt headCommit { oid } } } }'
+              else
+                q='mutation($id: ID!) { dequeuePullRequest(input: {id: $id}) { mergeQueueEntry { position state } } }'
+              fi
+              out="$(GH_TOKEN="$tok" gh api graphql -f query="$q" -f id="$node" 2>&1)"
+              rc=$?
+              echo "PROBE-PA06 control action=$ACTION pr=$PR token=$TOKEN_KIND exit=$rc response=$(printf '%s' "$out" | tr '\n' ' ' | cut -c1-600) utc=$(utc)"
+              ;;
+            *)
+              echo "PROBE-PA06 error=unknown-action"
+              exit 1
+              ;;
+          esac

+# PA06 probe (merge-queue relay), PA06.1: the credential-free relay. It runs for merge_group checks_requested on the
+# queue ref with no secrets, no Environment, no checkout, and empty permissions, and only records the group.
+# merge_group runs use the workflow definition inside the merge group commit, so this file is deployed to master
+# AND to the queue's base branch probe-pa06-base.
+# Canonical source: probes/pa06-merge-queue-relay/workflows/probe-pa06-relay.yml
+# Deployed copy:    .github/workflows/probe-pa06-relay.yml on master and probe-pa06-base (byte-identical).
+name: probe-pa06-relay
+run-name: probe-pa06-relay ${{ github.event.merge_group.head_sha }}
+
+on:
+  merge_group:
+    types: [checks_requested]
+
+permissions: {}
+
+jobs:
+  relay:
+    name: relay
+    if: ${{ startsWith(github.event.merge_group.base_ref, 'refs/heads/probe-pa06-') }}
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 5
+    permissions: {}
+    steps:
+      - name: Record the merge group (no credentials, no checkout)
+        env:
+          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.merge_group.head_sha }}
+          HEAD_REF: ${{ github.event.merge_group.head_ref }}
+          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.merge_group.base_sha }}
+          BASE_REF: ${{ github.event.merge_group.base_ref }}
+          SENDER: ${{ github.event.sender.login }}
+        run: |
+          echo "PROBE-PA06 job=relay head_sha=$HEAD_SHA head_ref=$HEAD_REF base_sha=$BASE_SHA base_ref=$BASE_REF"
+          echo "PROBE-PA06 job=relay ref=$GITHUB_REF sha=$GITHUB_SHA sender=$SENDER actor=$GITHUB_ACTOR run_id=$GITHUB_RUN_ID utc=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"

+# PA09 probe (run-list caps): acts on a submission as a DIFFERENT identity than its author - the test App's bot.
+#   edit-pr  edit the body of PR <target>            (pull_request_target edited, sent by the bot)
+#   comment  comment on issue or PR <target>         (issue_comment created, sent by the bot)
+#   rerun    re-run all jobs of workflow run <target> (a re-run triggered by the bot)
+# Dispatch-only: it never reacts to an event.
+# Canonical source: probes/pa09-run-list-caps/workflows/probe-pa09-act.yml
+# Deployed copy:    .github/workflows/probe-pa09-act.yml on master (byte-identical).

+
+on:
+  workflow_dispatch:
+    inputs:
+      nonce:
+        description: Unique marker that lets the dispatching script find this run
+        required: true
+        type: string
+      action:
+        description: edit-pr | comment | rerun
+        required: true
+        type: string
+      target:
+        description: PR/issue number, or workflow run id for rerun
+        required: true
+        type: string
+
+permissions: {}
+
+jobs:
+  act:
+    name: act
+    if: ${{ github.event.sender.login == 'jambolo' }}
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 5
+    permissions: {}
+    steps:
+      - name: Mint an App installation token
+        id: app
+        uses: actions/create-github-app-token@v3
+        with:
+          app-id: ${{ secrets.STEWARD_APP_ID }}
+          private-key: ${{ secrets.STEWARD_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
+          permission-actions: write
+          permission-issues: write
+          permission-pull-requests: write
+
+      - name: Act as the App's bot

+          GH_TOKEN: ${{ steps.app.outputs.token }}
+          ACTION: ${{ inputs.action }}
+          TARGET: ${{ inputs.target }}
+          NONCE: ${{ inputs.nonce }}
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          R="$GITHUB_REPOSITORY"
+          case "$TARGET" in '' | *[!0-9]*) echo "PROBE-PA09 error=target-not-a-number"; exit 1 ;; esac
+          case "$NONCE" in *[!A-Za-z0-9._-]*) echo "PROBE-PA09 error=bad-nonce"; exit 1 ;; esac
+          case "$ACTION" in
+            edit-pr) gh api -X PATCH "repos/$R/pulls/$TARGET" -f body="probe PA09 body edited by the App $NONCE" --jq '"number=\(.number)"' ;;
+            comment) gh api -X POST "repos/$R/issues/$TARGET/comments" -f body="probe PA09 comment by the App $NONCE" --jq '"comment_id=\(.id)"' ;;
+            rerun) gh api -X POST "repos/$R/actions/runs/$TARGET/rerun" ;;
+            *) echo "PROBE-PA09 error=unknown-action"; exit 1 ;;
+          esac
+          echo "PROBE-PA09 act action=$ACTION target=$TARGET utc=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"

+# PA09 probe (run-list caps): one cap evaluation as the design's gate would run it, with the job token and with the
+# App installation token: today's runs (created >= today UTC, paginated) and in-progress/queued runs of the listener,
+# the number of requests each needed, rate-limit headers, and every listed run's attribution fields. Then a
+# freshness test: the App comments on issue <trigger_issue> (the listener reacts) and the job measures how long the
+# new run takes to appear in the listing. The comment is the only write; the workflow is dispatch-only.
+# Canonical source: probes/pa09-run-list-caps/workflows/probe-pa09-count.yml
+# Deployed copy:    .github/workflows/probe-pa09-count.yml on master (byte-identical).
+name: probe-pa09-count
+run-name: probe-pa09-count ${{ inputs.nonce }}
+
+on:
+  workflow_dispatch:
+    inputs:
+      nonce:
+        description: Unique marker that lets the dispatching script find this run
+        required: true
+        type: string
+      trigger_issue:
+        description: Number of the open "[probe PA09]" issue used for the freshness test
+        required: true
+        type: string
+
+permissions: {}
+
+jobs:
+  count:
+    name: count
+    if: ${{ github.event.sender.login == 'jambolo' }}
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 15
+    permissions:
+      actions: read
+    steps:
+      - name: Mint an App installation token
+        id: app
+        uses: actions/create-github-app-token@v3
+        with:
+          app-id: ${{ secrets.STEWARD_APP_ID }}
+          private-key: ${{ secrets.STEWARD_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
+          permission-actions: read
+          permission-issues: write
+
+      - name: Cap evaluation with both tokens
+        env:
+          JOB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
+          APP_TOKEN: ${{ steps.app.outputs.token }}
+        run: |
+          set +e
+          R="$GITHUB_REPOSITORY"
+          TODAY="$(date -u +%Y-%m-%d)"
+          for WF in probe-pa09-listen.yml probe-pa09-follow.yml; do
+            for kind in job app; do
+              if [ "$kind" = job ]; then tok="$JOB_TOKEN"; else tok="$APP_TOKEN"; fi
+              n=0; listed=0; page=1; tc=unknown
+              while [ "$page" -le 10 ]; do
+                body="$(GH_TOKEN="$tok" gh api "repos/$R/actions/workflows/$WF/runs?created=%3E%3D$TODAY&per_page=100&page=$page" 2>&1)"
+                n=$((n + 1))
+                cnt="$(printf '%s' "$body" | jq '.workflow_runs | length' 2>/dev/null || echo error)"
+                tc="$(printf '%s' "$body" | jq '.total_count' 2>/dev/null || echo error)"
+                if [ "$cnt" = error ]; then echo "PROBE-PA09 count wf=$WF token=$kind error=$(printf '%s' "$body" | tr '\n' ' ' | cut -c1-300)"; break; fi
+                listed=$((listed + cnt))
+                if [ "$cnt" -lt 100 ]; then break; fi
+                page=$((page + 1))
+              done
+              ip="$(GH_TOKEN="$tok" gh api "repos/$R/actions/workflows/$WF/runs?status=in_progress&per_page=100" --jq .total_count 2>&1)"; n=$((n + 1))
+              qd="$(GH_TOKEN="$tok" gh api "repos/$R/actions/workflows/$WF/runs?status=queued&per_page=100" --jq .total_count 2>&1)"; n=$((n + 1))
+              echo "PROBE-PA09 count wf=$WF token=$kind today=$TODAY today_total_count=$tc today_listed=$listed in_progress=$ip queued=$qd requests=$n utc=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
+              GH_TOKEN="$tok" gh api -i "repos/$R/actions/workflows/$WF/runs?per_page=1" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r' | grep -iE '^(HTTP/|x-ratelimit-)' | tr '\n' ' ' | sed "s/^/PROBE-PA09 headers wf=$WF token=$kind: /"
+              echo
+            done
+          done
+          for WF in probe-pa09-listen.yml probe-pa09-follow.yml probe-pa03-schedule.yml; do
+            GH_TOKEN="$JOB_TOKEN" gh api "repos/$R/actions/workflows/$WF/runs?per_page=40" \
+              --jq ".workflow_runs[] | \"PROBE-PA09 run wf=$WF id=\(.id) attempt=\(.run_attempt) event=\(.event) status=\(.status) conclusion=\(.conclusion) actor=\(.actor.login) triggering_actor=\(.triggering_actor.login) prs=\([.pull_requests[].number] | join(\",\")) head_repo=\(.head_repository.full_name) created_at=\(.created_at) title=\(.display_title)\"" 2>&1 | head -n 40
+          done
+
+      - name: Freshness - how soon a just-triggered run appears in the listing
+        env:
+          JOB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
+          APP_TOKEN: ${{ steps.app.outputs.token }}
+          ISSUE: ${{ inputs.trigger_issue }}
+          NONCE: ${{ inputs.nonce }}
+        run: |
+          set +e
+          R="$GITHUB_REPOSITORY"
+          case "$ISSUE" in '' | *[!0-9]*) echo "PROBE-PA09 error=issue-not-a-number"; exit 1 ;; esac
+          before="$(GH_TOKEN="$JOB_TOKEN" gh api "repos/$R/actions/workflows/probe-pa09-listen.yml/runs?event=issue_comment&per_page=1" --jq '.workflow_runs[0].id // 0')"
+          t0=$(date +%s)
+          GH_TOKEN="$APP_TOKEN" gh api -X POST "repos/$R/issues/$ISSUE/comments" -f body="probe PA09 freshness comment $NONCE" --jq '"PROBE-PA09 fresh comment_id=\(.id) created_at=\(.created_at)"'
+          seen=no
+          for i in $(seq 1 10); do
+            line="$(GH_TOKEN="$JOB_TOKEN" gh api "repos/$R/actions/workflows/probe-pa09-listen.yml/runs?event=issue_comment&per_page=5" --jq ".workflow_runs[] | select(.id > $before) | \"id=\(.id) status=\(.status) created_at=\(.created_at)\"" | head -n 1)"
+            if [ -n "$line" ]; then
+              echo "PROBE-PA09 fresh first_seen $line after_s=$(($(date +%s) - t0)) checks=$i utc=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
+              seen=yes
+              break
+            fi
+            sleep 20
+          done
+          if [ "$seen" != yes ]; then echo "PROBE-PA09 fresh not_seen_after_checks=10"; fi

+# PA09 probe (run-list caps): a workflow_run follower of probe-pa09-listen. Its run-name copies the upstream run's
+# display_title (which carries the submission author's id), to test whether attribution survives a workflow_run hop.
+# Write-free.
+# Canonical source: probes/pa09-run-list-caps/workflows/probe-pa09-follow.yml
+# Deployed copy:    .github/workflows/probe-pa09-follow.yml on master (byte-identical).
+name: probe-pa09-follow
+run-name: probe-pa09-follow from=${{ github.event.workflow_run.id }} upstream=${{ github.event.workflow_run.display_title }}
+
+on:
+  workflow_run:
+    workflows: [probe-pa09-listen]
+    types: [completed]
+
+permissions: {}
+
+jobs:
+  record:
+    name: record
+    if: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success' }}
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 5
+    permissions: {}
+    steps:
+      - name: Record who triggered this run (no writes)
+        env:
+          UP_ID: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.id }}
+          UP_EVENT: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.event }}
+          UP_ACTOR: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.actor.login }}
+          UP_TRIGGERING: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.triggering_actor.login }}
+        run: echo "PROBE-PA09 follow actor=$GITHUB_ACTOR triggering_actor=$GITHUB_TRIGGERING_ACTOR upstream_id=$UP_ID upstream_event=$UP_EVENT upstream_actor=$UP_ACTOR upstream_triggering_actor=$UP_TRIGGERING utc=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"

+# PA09 probe (run-list caps): a write-free listener on "[probe PA09]" PRs and issues. Its run-name carries the
+# submission number and the submission AUTHOR's user id (not the actor), so the runs list returns them as
+# display_title. The job records actor, triggering actor, and sender, then stays in progress for 45 s so in-progress
+# counts can see it. It performs no writes, so it may react to events sent by the test App's bot.
+# Canonical source: probes/pa09-run-list-caps/workflows/probe-pa09-listen.yml
+# Deployed copy:    .github/workflows/probe-pa09-listen.yml on master (byte-identical).
+name: probe-pa09-listen
+run-name: >-
+  probe-pa09 ${{ github.event_name }} sub=${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.event.issue.number }}
+  author=${{ github.event.pull_request.user.id || github.event.issue.user.id }}
+
+on:
+  pull_request_target:
+    types: [opened, edited, reopened]
+  issues:
+    types: [opened, reopened]
+  issue_comment:
+    types: [created]
+
+permissions: {}
+
+jobs:
+  record:
+    name: record
+    if: >-
+      ${{ github.repository != 'jambolo/patch-steward-testbed-public' && (
+      startsWith(github.event.pull_request.title, '[probe PA09]') || startsWith(github.event.issue.title, '[probe PA09]')) }}
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 5
+    permissions: {}
+    steps:
+      - name: Record who triggered this run (no writes)
+        run: |
+          echo "PROBE-PA09 context event_name=$GITHUB_EVENT_NAME actor=$GITHUB_ACTOR actor_id=$GITHUB_ACTOR_ID triggering_actor=$GITHUB_TRIGGERING_ACTOR run_id=$GITHUB_RUN_ID run_attempt=$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT utc=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
+          jq -c '{action, sender: .sender.login, sender_id: .sender.id,
+            pr: (if .pull_request then {number: .pull_request.number, author: .pull_request.user.login, author_id: .pull_request.user.id, head_repo: .pull_request.head.repo.full_name} else null end),
+            issue: (if .issue then {number: .issue.number, author: .issue.user.login, author_id: .issue.user.id, is_pr: (.issue.pull_request != null)} else null end),
+            comment_author: .comment.user.login}' "$GITHUB_EVENT_PATH" | sed 's/^/PROBE-PA09 event=/'
+          sleep 45
